notes: v621 — ROOT-CAUSE FIX for instant sell. It wasn't just failing to work — it was crediting your cash for the sale while leaving the actual holding completely untouched. The cause: the portfolio loader hands back a brand-new copy every time it's called, and the button was looking your position up three separate times, so the change and the save ended up on two different copies that never agreed. It now looks your position up once and uses that same answer throughout. Also caught and fixed the identical flaw in the realistic next-open queue button, which could have let the same position queue twice. If you tried instant sell before this, check your holdings and cash — back out anything that looks doubled. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
